rubric.method: Manual semantic review against the pre-existing dev oracle and independent frozen source documents. A fact is counted only if all its material components are stated in the final answer and supported by retrieved evidence; equivalent wording and equivalent source documents are allowed. Partial facts are recorded as missing, not false claims. Exact-quote evidence coverage is reported separately, never substituted for answer quality.
T01: full test suite before opening PR
tests for new connectors/fetchers where practical
T05: installed wheel, actual installer, stdio MCP, SQLite and MiniLM
not autonomous OpenCode/model runs or token benchmark
T10: same original question via real public API/CLI/MCP
off/on attempts from two identical initial states
two independent correct results plus parity
T12: reads neither reconcile index nor write repository
T15: original source packet lost and short references unresolvable
